thread:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — I sketched a prioritization ladder for the GA launch. Need to confirm which items are MUST vs NICE-TO-HAVE before we lock the cutoff. TL;DR: SLA, docs, oncall, monitoring, pricing validation.
Diego (Eng): Can you drop the ladder image/gdoc? want to map dev effort.
Ava (PM): https://rwd.in/l/launch-ladder (notes + canvas). Top rung (MUST): 99.9% uptime SLO, fallback model variants, docs for API/SDK, oncall rota coverage, pricing table + billing e2e.
Priya (SRE): 99.9% is fine for initial GA but we need clear degradation plan. What counts as "fallback model variant" here — smaller model only?
Ava (PM): Yes. Fallback = lower-cost model variant + circuit-breaker policy. Must be automated for region failover.
Diego (Eng): Engineering concerns: automated fallback requires config hooks in routing layer. ETA 2 sprints for canary + fallback integration. Could we scope to manual failover for first week?
Priya (SRE): Manual failover implies longer MTTR risk. If we accept manual, we need runbook + oncall DR drill.
Maya (Support): Support needs a concise FAQ + triage matrix for customers hitting degraded performance. Also a billing FAQ for price changes when fallback fires.
Liam (FinOps): Important: pricing validation — we need sample customer workloads to test unit economics with batching/quantization enabled. Who owns collecting those samples?
Ava (PM): Action: sales to provide 3 canonical workloads. I'll ping Sales after this thread.
Diego (Eng): For docs: we need three doc artifacts for GA: quickstart (5-min), SDK examples (node/python), and behavior guarantees section (SLA + fallback effects). I can own SDK examples.
Maya (Support): I'll draft the quickstart and triage matrix; need review from eng for accuracy.
Priya (SRE): Monitoring: must include latency p95/p99, queue length, error budget burn rate metric with alerting thresholds. Also synthetic canary every region. ops-bot can create alerts once metrics are namespaced.
ops-bot: Created alert template: rwd.ga.slo.error_budget_burn_rate (editable).
Liam (FinOps): Pricing: we must publish unit pricing and a note about "fallback cost delta" if customers are switched to smaller models. Legal insists on an explicit clause.
Ava (PM): Good — include fallback cost delta as a line item in pricing table. Also add a short blurb in TOS and notify Sales for contract language.
Diego (Eng): Rollout plan question: do we gate GA on automated fallback + alerting, or allow GA if runbooks and manual failover are validated?
Priya (SRE): My recommendation: automated fallback OR validated drill + 24/7 oncall for first 2 weeks. Otherwise, we risk high customer impact.
Ava (PM): OK decision: Gate = (1) docs + SDK quickstart published, (2) monitoring alerts + synthetic canaries configured, (3) fallback: automated OR runbook + validated drill, (4) pricing + billing FAQ live. If all met — green for GA.
Maya (Support): Who signs off on runbook drill? Ops lead + support manager?
Priya (SRE): Ops lead (me) + Maya to co-sign drill. We'll schedule a 1-hr DR test.
Liam (FinOps): I'll run pricing sims once we get the 3 workloads. Expect results within 4 business days.
Diego (Eng): I'll scope the routing toggles and drop a PR for canary -> fallback config this week.
Ava (PM): Great. I'll convert these into owners + due dates in the launch canvas. Owners: Diego (fallback + SDK), Priya (monitoring + drill), Maya (support docs), Liam (pricing sims), Ava (customer workloads + launch decision).
Maya (Support): One more ask — can we get a short template for customer comms if we need to enable fallback for a customer during an incident?
Ava (PM): Yes. I'll draft a 2-line customer-facing template and share here.
Priya (SRE): Final check: do we need expanded SLA tiers for Dedicated customers at GA, or postpone to post-GA?
Liam (FinOps): Post-GA ok — we can document tiering as roadmap item. For GA we keep a single published SLA and offer contractual exceptions via sales.
Ava (PM): Noted. I'll update the ladder and push final checklist by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has blockers to the gating criteria above, shout now. :thumbsup:
Diego (Eng): No blockers from eng.
Maya (Support): No blockers.
Priya (SRE): No blockers.
Liam (FinOps): No blockers.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: launch-ladder finalization meeting tomorrow 10:00am.
